name: Rook CLI
description: Tests, evaluates, red-teams and regression-checks AI agents you own from the terminal: it derives scenarios, runs them against the agent and grades the evidence. By TestMu AI.

skills.name: Agent Discovery
skills.description: Explores an agent from its source, requirements or MCP servers to learn which tools it has before any test is written.

skills.name: Scenario Generation
skills.description: Derives test scenarios and invocation profiles for the agent under test, for review before anything runs.

skills.name: Run and Grade
skills.description: Invokes the target agent, grades the evidence, and separates Pass, Fail and Unable to Verify results.

skills.name: Headless CI Runs
skills.description: Runs every step headless in CI with LT_USERNAME and LT_ACCESS_KEY from secrets, with tool grants passed up front.

skills.name: Saved Results
skills.description: Reads and explains saved Rook results without starting setup, a new run or paid analysis.
